categories.main_business_segments: Zhengyuan Geomatics Group operates primarily in three segments: surveying and geographic information services, underground pipeline network services, and new smart city construction and operation services. These segments encompass aerial remote sensing, geophysical exploration, digital city construction, and integrated smart city solutions focusing on urban management, public safety, and environmental governance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced GIS, AI, big data, cloud computing, IoT, and digital twin technologies. It employs multi-modal remote sensing, 3D city modeling, underground pipeline detection integrating inertial navigation and geophysical methods, and AI-driven leak detection and risk warning systems. Proprietary platforms include 3D GIS, spatiotemporal cloud platforms, and integrated IoT management systems, supporting comprehensive data acquisition, processing, and application.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments and state-owned enterprises, with expanding engagement in private enterprises. The company serves urban infrastructure, energy, chemical parks, environmental protection, and emergency management sectors. Its smart city solutions target municipal utilities like gas, water, and drainage, while its surveying services support land registration, urban planning, and natural resource management.
categories.geographic_coverage: Zhengyuan operates nationwide across China, with significant presence in regions including Beijing, Shandong, Zhejiang, Hebei, Hubei, Anhui, Fujian, and Hainan. It also maintains subsidiaries and joint ventures in multiple provinces, supporting regional smart city initiatives and infrastructure projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the geographic information industry supply chain. It undertakes data acquisition, processing, software development, system integration, and operational services, providing end-to-end solutions from data collection to application deployment in smart city and infrastructure management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include dual-track development of foundational and emerging businesses, focusing on smart pipeline networks, aerial remote sensing, digital parks, intelligent mining, smart factories, and digital carbon management. R&D emphasizes AI integration, multi-source data fusion, high-precision underground pipeline detection, and development of intelligent monitoring and risk warning platforms. The company fosters innovation through a dedicated digital technology research institute and collaborative projects with academic and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based sales of surveying and mapping services, underground pipeline operation and maintenance services, and smart city construction and operational services. The company secures contracts via public tenders and commercial negotiations, delivering customized solutions and ongoing maintenance services. It also benefits from government subsidies and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhengyuan is a leading domestic player with strong technical capabilities and comprehensive service offerings in the geographic information and smart city sectors. It holds multiple high-level qualifications and industry certifications, and is recognized as a strategic partner in international geographic information forums. The company faces competition from traditional surveying firms and emerging tech companies entering GIS and smart city markets but maintains competitive advantages through integrated solutions and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 661 million, a 26% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 173 million. Total assets stood at RMB 3.44 billion, slightly down from the prior year. Despite recent financial challenges, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures representing 8.77% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to long-term growth and technological advancement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhengyuan emphasizes its full-space (above and underground) geographic data acquisition and integrated smart city solutions as unique value propositions. Its proprietary technologies enable high-precision, automated 3D modeling, intelligent pipeline detection and maintenance, and AI-powered risk monitoring. The company’s comprehensive service chain and deep industry expertise allow it to deliver tailored, innovative solutions that enhance urban management, public safety, and environmental sustainability.
